items.quote: 24:1 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 24:2 Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to have the Israelites bring pure beaten olive oil to keep the lamps burning continually. The document gives only verse numbers 24:1-2. Naming the book as Leviticus comes from model-prior, not from the text, and is unverified.
items.actor: the children of Israel (commanded by the LORD through Moses)
items.object: pure oil olive beaten, for the lamps
items.mechanism: beaten olive oil used as lamp fuel so the lamps burn continually
